issue.title: The mechanism to provide MockitoConfiguration is not compatible with java 9 jigsaw
issue.body:
Error on mockito 2.2.9

If your module is a test module it cannot export a package that is already exported by another package,

it is not possible to create the `org.mockito.configuration.MockitoConfiguration` inside a jigsaw module

```
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-compiler-plugin:3.6.0:testCompile (default-testCompile) on project sfm-datastax: Compilation failure: Compilation failure:
[ERROR] /home/aroger/dev/github/SimpleFlatMapper/sfm-datastax/src/test/java/org/mockito/configuration/MockitoConfiguration.java:[1] error: package exists in another module: mockito.core
[ERROR] /home/aroger/dev/github/SimpleFlatMapper/sfm-datastax/src/test/java/org/mockito/configuration/MockitoConfiguration.java:[3,42] error: cannot find symbol
[ERROR] symbol: class DefaultMockitoConfiguration
[ERROR] /home/aroger/dev/github/SimpleFlatMapper/sfm-datastax/src/test/java/org/mockito/configuration/MockitoConfiguration.java:[4,4] error: method does not override or implement a method from a supertype
```

You are asking for the way Mockito is configured through an org.mockito.configuration.MockitoConfiguration class to work inside a Java 9 named module, where the test module cannot export a package that another module already exports. The current source no longer has that class, and the extension points are now plugins such as MockMaker. I have logged this as a request to make configuration and plugin loading usable from modular test setups."}
